resources.string: Every model runs on your phone. Your chats never leave the device — no account, no cloud, no tracking.
Browse text, vision and code models, download in the background over Wi-Fi, and chat from a plane or a dead zone.
Streaming replies, per-chat settings, photo input for vision models, and web search as a tool you can switch off.
Choose your language, switch between color themes or dynamic colors, and adjust fonts and text size for a comfortable experience.
Add the TinyModels widget for quick access, check device fit and storage, and manage or benchmark your downloaded models anytime.
